title: 上海高考翻译背诵-76-25一模

items.zh: 任何时候都要保持冷静、而非盲目行事。
items.en: One should stay calm at all times instead of acing blindly.

items.zh: 你能帮我去文具店买一把三角尺吗?
items.en: Would you like to do me a favor and go to the stationery store to buy me a set square?

items.zh: 这枚金牌不仅见证了该运动员的成长和蜕变，更体现了中国健儿的奋斗和坚守。
items.en: The gold medal has not only witnessed the athlete’s growth and transformation, but also embodies Chinese athletes’ struggle and perseverance.

items.zh: 国家艺术馆收藏了大量的国内外艺术作品，人们漫步其间,探寻时光的足迹，感受历史与文化的交融。
items.en: The state art gallery houses a large collection of domestic and international works, where people wander to explore the footprints of time, experiencing the blending of history and culture.
